scope: Transfer of the prepared Ego action windows to the remote GPU host
summary: The initial full-tree rsync failed because the remote parent did not exist, and a later compact sync invocation failed because that rsync build does not support --info=progress2.
evidence: The first transfer exited before writing the experiment because its remote parent directory was absent.
The compact retry with --info=progress2 was rejected as an unsupported option and made no writes.
A full uncompressed tree transfer was stopped after proving impractically slow; the source data remained intact.
lessons: Remote capability checks must create the exact parent first and use only options supported by the installed rsync before transferring video assets.
limitations: These transfer attempts did not establish a complete immutable GPU input pack.
next_actions: Build a compact 832x480 pack, create the exact remote directory, use supported --progress output, and compare every transferred SHA-256.
